_comment: Local-only development overrides. Gitignored (see .gitignore). Generated by the local-Keycloak setup task — points the WebApi at the locally-running Keycloak (http://localhost:8180) with realm 'asps', client 'asps-webapi', and a pre-created dev user 'isaac' / 'isaac' (which Program.cs grants the Admin role to). Keycloak runs on 8180 (not the default 8080) to avoid collision with the desktop agent's extension WebSocket port range 8080-8484. To regenerate the client secret rerun the Keycloak setup script and replace the value below.
